title: Formation of gp37 LTF needle trimers-OmpC complex
author: Mohammad Z. Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.77vhrn6
materials: Formation of gp37 LTF needle trimers-OmpC complex

steps.title: Coat plate with gp37 and OmpC standards
steps.instruction: Coat columns 1‑10 (duplicate) of a flat‑bottom 96‑well Maxisorp plate with 100 ng gp37 LTF needle trimers in 100 µl coating buffer (0.05 M carbonate‑bicarbonate, pH 9.6). Coat columns 11‑12 with serial dilutions of OmpC protein in the same buffer for the standard curve. Incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash plate
steps.instruction: Wash each well twice with 250 µl phosphate‑buffered saline containing 0.05 % Tween 20 (PBS‑T).

steps.title: Block wells
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl per well of 1X casein blocking buffer (Sigma Aldrich) and incubate 2 hr at room temperature.

steps.title: Add OmpC or PBS
steps.instruction: To columns 1‑10 add OmpC so that the gp37:OmpC molar ratio is 1:1; to columns 11‑12 add PBS only. Incubate 2 hr at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash and add primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash wells four times with 250 µl PBS‑T. Add anti‑OmpC mouse serum diluted 1:5,000 and incubate 1 hr at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash and add HRP secondary
steps.instruction: Wash wells four times with 250 µl PBS‑T. Add 100 µl per well of HRP‑conjugated rabbit anti‑mouse IgG (Invitrogen) diluted 1:5,000. Incubate 1 hr at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash and develop with TMB
steps.instruction: Wash wells four times with 250 µl PBS‑T. Add 100 µl per well of TMB substrate and incubate 25 min at room temperature to develop color.

steps.title: Read absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure absorbance at 650 nm using a VERSA max ELISA reader (Molecular Devices).

steps.title: Calculate bound OmpC
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of bound OmpC by comparing sample absorbance to the standard curve constructed from the serially diluted OmpC standards incubated with anti‑OmpC antibody.
